tasks.description: Add a new user-facing action page `docs/get-started/actions/runCode.md` documenting the `runCode` action: it assembles and runs code in Python, Bash, or JavaScript; `language` is optional and defaults to shell execution; fields include `code`, `args`, `workingDirectory`, `exitCodes` (default `[0]`), and `output` (string or `/regex/`). Include examples mirroring the runShell page style and a link to the schema reference.
Add a `runCode` row to the actions table in `docs/get-started/concepts.md` linking to the new runCode action page, so the action is discoverable alongside checkLink, find, runShell, etc.

Document the new `viewport_width` and `viewport_height` integer options in `docs/references/schemas/context.md` (and the contexts guide `docs/get-started/config/contexts/index.md`), noting they override `width`/`height` respectively.

Update `docs/references/schemas/find.md` to document that `click` now accepts either a boolean or an object with a `button` property (`left`, `right`, `middle`), and add an example showing the object form.
